status: Proposed father-son pilot; storyboard, cost ceiling and actual keyframes not yet approved.
intendedInterpretation: The son has quietly kept a dry place for his father; care can travel in both directions.

pacing.hypothesis: Readable dry-seat evidence and a restrained familiar response can carry a ten-second act of care without dialogue or shock.
pacing.hook: Why is the boy keeping his coat across the empty seat?
pacing.revealEvidence: The lifted coat exposes a lighter dry rectangle; the boy looks toward his father and the freed seat.

beats.job: Read boy, standing father and coat-covered seat.
One controlled coat lift reveals the protected seat.
Dry patch and boy's offered place remain visible; father notices.
After an ellipse father is already seated; they turn slightly toward one another.
Small familiar smiles settle without a new gesture or event.

cutReasons: At 5s omit sitting/contact mechanics and direct attention to the father's response; retain the bench axis and light.

identityBible.Ishaan: Fictional boy about seven, medium-brown skin, short dark curls, plain rust knitted sweater and beige trousers. Dry and comfortably sheltered. Natural child proportions; no requested likeness to a real child.
identityBible.Ravi: Fictional father about 38, medium-brown skin, short dark hair, short stubble, plain muted navy shirt damp at the shoulders and charcoal trousers. Tired but gentle posture, not angry or ill.
identityBible.props: One matte dark-olive rectangular coat, one straight three-board wooden bench, one modest unbranded park shelter. No bags, readable writing or extra people.
identityBible.anchorPrompt: Create the literal opening frame of an original 9:16 cinematic father-son film, not a character sheet. Under a modest park shelter during gentle rain, fictional Ishaan, a seven-year-old boy with medium-brown skin and short dark curls, sits screen-left on a straight three-board wooden bench, wearing a plain rust knitted sweater and beige trousers. His right hand rests on one matte dark-olive coat lying flat over the empty seat to his right. His fictional father Ravi, about 38, medium-brown skin, short dark hair and short stubble, stands screen-right facing the bench, wearing a plain muted navy shirt damp at the shoulders and charcoal trousers. He looks tired but gentle. Medium-wide two-shot at seated adult eye height, natural perspective and enough focus depth for both faces, the boy's right hand and the covered seat. Broad soft overcast daylight from camera-right, gentle shelter fill, soft grounded contact shadows and an unobtrusive rainy gray background. Keep the faces and story prop centrally readable in portrait framing. Ordinary clothed family, quiet natural expression. No text, logo, extra people, exaggerated tears, body contact, collage or dramatic camera effect.

continuity.geography: Ishaan is always screen-left; Ravi is always screen-right. Camera stays on the path side of the bench axis. Both faces and the seat remain readable.
continuity.propOwnership: Only Ishaan's right hand lifts the olive coat onto his own lap. Ravi does not take it. No coat duplication or switched hand.
continuity.light: Broad cloudy daylight from camera-right throughout. The dry seat is lighter material amid damp darker wood, not a newly invented spotlight.
continuity.match: The cut deliberately skips Ravi sitting: he is standing before it and already settled afterward. This is an ellipse, not continuous sitting motion.
intentionalChanges: coat moves from right seat to boy's lap
father is already seated after the cut

lightingPlan.key: Large diffuse source above camera-right; no sunny beam or hard spotlight.

shadowMap.behavior: Soft contact grounding; no detached or sharply moving silhouette.

intentionalChanges: Coat reveals material dryness; source lighting remains unchanged.

shots.prompt: Animate only from the accepted literal opening image toward the accepted end image over five seconds. Ishaan performs one controlled primary action: his right hand lifts the single olive coat from the empty right seat and places it on his own lap, exposing the lighter dry wood. Preserve the boy's child proportions and rust sweater, father's adult face/stubble/navy shirt, hand ownership, bench boards, screen sides, rain and soft cloudy right-side light. No sitting, camera move, embrace, morph, duplicate coat, extra people, dialogue, text or exaggerated tears. Exact action timing must be checked in the result.

Animate the accepted b-start toward accepted b-end over five seconds as one quiet response. Locked portrait medium two-shot. Ishaan stays seated left, olive coat on his lap; Ravi is ALREADY SEATED right on the dry bench place, hands separate on his own knees. singlePassPrompt: Planning alternative only; do not use text-only video to bypass accepted keyframes. Ten-second original portrait father-son scene in a modest rainy park shelter. Seven-year-old Ishaan in a plain rust sweater sits screen-left with an olive coat covering an empty bench seat; father Ravi in a damp navy shirt stands screen-right. In the first half, one controlled right-hand coat lift reveals the dry place saved for his father. At the midpoint cut deliberately to the same geography in a slightly tighter shot: Ravi is already seated on the right, boy and coat remain left. They turn slightly toward each other, exchange small familiar smiles and settle. Stable identities, clear seat evidence and cloudy light from camera-right. No animated sitting, hug, transformation, dialogue, text or extra people. Actual timing and emotional reading require inspection, not assumed prompt compliance.
